items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: And the group that I had, on bass I had Truck Parham and I had Red Richards on piano and Freddie Moore on drums and Joe Barofaldi on clarinet and myself.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

And the group that I had, on bass I had Truck Parham and I had Red Richards on piano and Freddie Moore on drums and Joe Barofaldi on clarinet and myself. That was the group I took over and we had a lot of fun. Ida went with me all through the tour.
How long did the tour last?
